comment: The one table of the coordinate-bearing fields of a layout building (GenBuilding, schema.ts; S2_ROOMS_PLAN.md R4, section 7 item 5). Read by Tools/TrainingGround/src/levelgen/buildingCoordFields.ts (finalizeDraftToLayout draft -> layout, rotateContent) and Scripts/Editor/build_levelgen_map.py (_building_local); a coordinate field missing here fails the coverage tests (buildingCoordFields.test.ts, test_build_levelgen_buildings.py). path: dot-separated keys, '[]' = every element of that array. kind: point = [x, y] cm; point_list = [[x, y], ...]; rect = [[minx, miny], [maxx, maxy]]; bounds = { min: [x, y], max: [x, y] }; direction = a unit vector (turns, never moves); yaw = degrees (UE yaw sense). frame: 'building' = the building's own UNROTATED frame (absolute cm, the frame `footprint` is in: with `rotation` the point stands at its turn about the footprint centre; a rigid move of the building translates it with the footprint centre); 'world' = layout coordinates (a rigid move rotates it with the building). `rotation` itself is the building frame's angle, not a field here: rotateContent adds the turn to it, _building_local drops it, a draft building has none. not_coordinates: number pairs that are sizes, not positions (the coverage walker skips them).
